defects: Nonnegativity hypothesis is required for all x : ℝ (global), whereas gold only requires it on Ioi 0 — strictly stronger/more restrictive hypothesis that excludes valid functions negative outside [0,∞)
Antitone hypothesis is global (Antitone f on all of ℝ) instead of AntitoneOn f (Ici 0) as in gold — strictly stronger hypothesis restricting applicability to functions monotone on the whole real line
Integrability domain is Ici 0 instead of Ioi 0 (minor, essentially equivalent up to a measure-zero point, not a substantive defect)
